quests.title: Orientation
quests.summary: Find the Welcome Office. The Tutorial Goon runs orientation, and he is the only person on this floor who has ever seen the outside.

objectives.label: Find the Welcome Office and talk to the Tutorial Goon

quests.title: Trial by XP
quests.summary: The Goon switched your XP on. Now earn it the way he did — grind the swarm and reach level 2.

quests.title: Pest Control for Beginners
quests.summary: Thin out rats and slimes to earn the Goon's signature on the boss door. It takes three signatures, and the other two live in the same room he does.

quests.title: The Director's Shortlist
quests.summary: The Merchant has to gear you and the Broker has to arm you before the boss door moves. Two stops, two errands, and one very frosty room.

quests.title: Neighborhood Watch
quests.summary: Defeat the Slime Rat, then return to the Spell Broker for your spellbook. He'll be delighted for you. He will not sound delighted for you.

objectives.label: Return to the Spell Broker and claim your spellbook

quests.title: Leave the Floor
quests.summary: The Director has made the call — the Floor Boss stands between you and Floor 2. Take it out and hit the stairs before the show moves on without you.

quests.title: The Merchant's Disgusting Little Errand
quests.summary: The Merchant will not open the shop until you fetch him one very particular souvenir. He says it's not for the shop. He says it's for the room. Don't think about the room.

template.fetchLabel: Retrieve his "special" rat tail (dropped in a far dungeon room)
